facts.fact: The Africa Capital Report's review of November 2023 to November 2026 found no equity or quasi-equity transaction into a Lesotho tech startup verifiable at transaction level, while stating this is not proof that no private investment took place.

facts.fact: The Africa Capital Report says Pay Lesotho is reported to process M20 million in monthly transactions across more than 300 merchants.
